statement: The pinned v7.3-rc1 hid-steam interface description identifies seven Puck interfaces, with non-HID interfaces 0-1, controller slots 2-5 and a pogo interface 6. The pinned SDL Triton driver selects receiver interfaces 2-5. Linux hidapi reports interface_number -1 when UHID has no USB parent, so a single UHID node does not satisfy that SDL receiver selection. This consumer evidence does not independently measure the physical receiver descriptor or establish faithful USB behavior.

applicability.scope: Consumer evidence only; no physical observation or device-side protocol promotion
